snippet.title: BRAINSTORM Update Trailer | Calamity Mod
snippet.description:
The winds shift and your mind drifts... a Brainstorm is on the horizon.
Calamity Mod v2.1 features 3,000+ assorted changes, flattens the convoluted difficulty system, completely reworks dozens of weapons, rebuilds the Draedon labs, and is packed with hundreds of optimizations and balance improvements.

CRACK THE SKY - Fight the entirely reworked Devourer of Gods, with a new and overwhelmingly powerful second phase! Are you stronger than a deity?
CEREBRAL PAIN - The new Rev+ Brain of Cthulhu fight will test your intellect as you weave through its orchestrated dance of madness. Is your mind sharp enough to cut through?
ENTER THE STRATUS SPHERE - Augment your loadout with several entirely new weapon sets. Perfectly balanced. Trust.
 
And that's not all!
Visual and gameplay reworks for Providence, Supreme Calamitas, Ravager and more are in this update.

READ MORE on the OFFICIAL NEWSLETTER: https://calamitymod.com/post.html?post=brainstormtrailer

===
Composition by TYESKI, CDMusic and Moonburn. Video editing by Moonburn; end slate by Brav.

Video editor channels:
- MOONBURN -- https://www.youtube.com/@ogscule
- BRAV -- https://www.youtube.com/@brav1122

Special thanks to:
The trailer script writers - CDMusic and LordMetarex
The trailer scene builders - LordMetarex, CDMusic and jasper
Thumbnail and splash artists - _tofuupudding and carnymassacre
... and you! Thank you for watching!

===
CALAMITY MOD LINKS BELOW

OFFICIAL SITE - Download, Information, Newsletter: https://calamitymod.com/
OFFICIAL DISCORD - Community, Announcements, Spoilers: https://discord.gg/calamity

OFFICIAL PATREON - Support The Team: https://patreon.com/CalamityMod
MOUSEPAD SHOP - YouPads Store: https://youpads.com/calamity/

===
